description: This file defines data structures, enums, and classes related to vector store management, configuration, and search functionalities within a larger software project. It includes models for vector store configuration, responses, requests, and indexing, primarily using pydantic and TypedDict for type safety.

classes.name: SupportedVectorStoreIntegrations
classes.description: Enum for supported vector store integrations, including 'bedrock' and 'ragflow'.

classes.name: LiteLLM_VectorStoreConfig
classes.description: TypedDict for parameters to initialize a vector store on Litellm proxy.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore
classes.description: TypedDict representing a managed vector store object stored in the database.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStoreListResponse
classes.description: TypedDict for listing response of vector stores.

classes.name: VectorStoreUpdateRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating vector store details.

classes.name: VectorStoreDeleteRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for requesting deletion of a vector store.

classes.name: VectorStoreInfoRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for requesting information about a specific vector store.

classes.name: VectorStoreResultContent
classes.description: TypedDict for content of a vector store search result.

classes.name: VectorStoreSearchResult
classes.description: TypedDict for a vector store search result item.

classes.name: VectorStoreSearchResponse
classes.description: TypedDict for the response after a vector store search.

classes.name: VectorStoreSearchOptionalRequestParams
classes.description: TypedDict for optional search parameters.

classes.name: VectorStoreSearchRequest
classes.description: TypedDict for search request body.

classes.name: VectorStoreExpirationPolicy
classes.description: TypedDict for vector store expiration policy.

classes.name: VectorStoreAutoChunkingStrategy
classes.description: TypedDict for auto chunking strategy configuration.

classes.name: VectorStoreStaticChunkingStrategyConfig
classes.description: TypedDict for static chunking strategy configuration.

classes.name: VectorStoreStaticChunkingStrategy
classes.description: TypedDict for static chunking strategy.

classes.name: VectorStoreChunkingStrategy
classes.description: TypedDict for union type of chunking strategies.

classes.name: VectorStoreFileCounts
classes.description: TypedDict for file counts in a vector store.

classes.name: VectorStoreCreateOptionalRequestParams
classes.description: TypedDict for optional create parameters.

classes.name: VectorStoreCreateRequest
classes.description: TypedDict for create request body.

classes.name: VectorStoreCreateResponse
classes.description: TypedDict for create response data.

classes.name: IndexCreateLiteLLMParams
classes.description: Pydantic model for index creation parameters.

classes.name: IndexCreateRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for index creation request.

classes.name: BaseVectorStoreAuthCredentials
classes.description: TypedDict for vector store auth credentials.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStoreIndex
classes.description: Pydantic model for managed vector store index object.

classes.name: VectorStoreIndexType
classes.description: Enum for vector store index types ('read', 'write').

classes.name: VectorStoreIndexEndpoints
classes.description: TypedDict for endpoints related to vector store index.

classes.name: VECTOR_STORE_OPENAI_PARAMS
classes.description: Literal list of OpenAI parameter names for vector store queries.

classes.name: VectorStoreToolParams
classes.description: Dataclass for parameters extracted from a file_search tool definition.
